{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-nj-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"9abe3b96efc40899a8d17b0575071e0b4a7790e7dd9aa6b71acdc4aea4fcb93e","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-nj-class-d:lineage:51","source_registry_sha256":"057b72c7c679c997f56ae00ef97a6b14dbe264551f4121b9bf67b0457d9cf7c1","source_liveness_sha256":"1ca7bfbb9e3c0a6b19e5e808ecab6fe8329f3b4799e394abc260d65c1d6513e7"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Driver programs, surcharges and points confusables and continuation details","heading":"C2 — Confusable pairs and knowledge-graph hints: Driver Improvement versus Probationary credits, one-year versus two-year probation, surcharge threshold versus duration, the two compacts, and continuation details on hearings, mature driver classes, enforcement areas and further point values","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusable pairs and knowledge-graph hints: Driver Improvement versus Probationary credits, one-year versus two-year probation, surcharge threshold versus duration, the two compacts, and continuation details on hearings, mature driver classes, enforcement areas and further point values
Confusable pairs among point and program rules, followed by continuation facts the C block left out for size; each block ties to one handbook page, and hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A02
A finished Driver Improvement Program removes three points, while a finished Probationary Driver Program removes up to three points. [A02]
Why it matters: group point credits; confusable exactly three versus up to three.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0136]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A02
The probation after a Driver Improvement Program or restoration lasts one year, while the new-driver probationary period that starts with a permit lasts two years. [A02]
Why it matters: group probation; confusable one-year versus two-year probation.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0136]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A04
Surcharges apply once a driver has six or more points within three years, and they keep applying for as long as six or more points posted in the preceding three years remain on the record. [A04]
Why it matters: group surcharges; confusable threshold versus duration.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0138]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A08
The Nonresident Violator Compact makes visiting drivers answer for tickets as residents would, while the Driver License Compact shares violation records so out-of-state tickets land on the home record. [A08]
Why it matters: group compacts; confusable the two compacts.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A07
Speeding 15 to 29 mph over the limit carries 4 points, but 30 mph or more over jumps to 5. [A07]
Why it matters: group speeding points; confusable the two upper speeding bands.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A02
When a driver is granted a hearing, the MVC Chief Administrator or an Administrative Law Judge decides whether to suspend driving privileges. [A02]
Why it matters: group driver programs; difficulty medium.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0136]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A02
Driver Improvement and Probationary Driver classes are taught by a licensed Statewide Safety Organization or a New Jersey-licensed driving school approved for that program. [A02]
Why it matters: group driver programs; difficulty low.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0136]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A03
Besides classroom courses, the MVC lists approved online defensive driving providers. [A03]
Why it matters: group point credits; difficulty low.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0137]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A03
Various providers offer a six-hour driver safety class, open to everyone and also available online, that can earn a multi-year insurance discount and a two-point reduction where applicable. [A03]
Why it matters: group mature drivers; difficulty medium.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0137]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A05
Traffic laws apply not only on highways and roadways but also on parking areas, driveways and grounds owned and maintained by government entities. [A05]
Why it matters: group point system; difficulty medium.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0139]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A05
Motor vehicle convictions may also raise the premiums an insurance company charges. [A05]
Why it matters: group surcharges; difficulty low.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0139]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A06
On the New Jersey Turnpike, Garden State Parkway and Atlantic City Expressway, moving against traffic carries 2 points and improper passing carries 4. [A06]
Why it matters: group point values; difficulty high.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec12-R13 | anchor: A06
Driving a construction vehicle faster than 45 mph carries 3 points. [A06]
Why it matters: group point values; difficulty high.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec12-R14 | anchor: A06
Failing to obey an officer's direction and failing to observe traffic signals each carry 2 points. [A06]
Why it matters: group point values; difficulty medium.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec12-R15 | anchor: A07
Failing to yield to an emergency vehicle and failing to yield at an intersection each carry 2 points. [A07]
Why it matters: group point values; difficulty medium.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec12-R16 | anchor: A07
Driving in an unsafe manner carries 4 points, but only for a third or later violation within five years of the previous one. [A07]
Why it matters: group point values; confusable unsafe versus careless driving.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec12-R17 | anchor: A07
Failing to stop for a traffic light, failing to stop at a flashing red signal and failing to signal properly each carry 2 points. [A07]
Why it matters: group point values; difficulty medium.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec12-R18 | anchor: A08
The Nonresident Violator Compact covers 44 states plus the District of Columbia and excludes parking or standing, weight limit and hazmat violations. [A08]
Why it matters: group compacts; difficulty high.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec12-R19 | anchor: A08
Nonresident drivers keep due process protection and cannot be detained out of state under that compact. [A08]
Why it matters: group compacts; difficulty medium.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0142]
